name: xTool D1 Pro 20W
tagline: 20W The most popular open-frame diode laser for makers who outgrow entry-level machines
tldr: xTool D1 Pro 20W is the 20W SKU on the xTool xtool d1 pro line. A well-built open-frame diode laser available up to 20W. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: 20W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: Clear acrylic cutting (diode light passes through)

pros: 20W The most popular open-frame diode laser for makers who outgrow entry-level machines
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Swappable laser head on the same chassis : upgrade wattage without a new machine
Work area 430 × 390 mm (16.9 × 15.4 in) on this chassis
Balanced engrave and cut : typical 8 mm basswood in multiple passes
Reference engrave job on this module: ~11–15 min
cons: Higher modules in this line (40W) add cut speed and depth
Verify the 20W SKU : same chassis, different modules
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W module on xTool D1 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.
mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic
